import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan;

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room(int i, int j) {
            this.i = i;
            this.j = j;
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected() {
            setInfected(0);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (!infected[timestamp]) return;
            setInfected(timestamp + 1);

            if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int N;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, ptr;

        Dinic(int n) {
            N = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int cid = ptr[v]; cid < g.get(v).size(); cid++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(cid);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                    int tr = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, e.cap));
                    if (tr > 0) {
                        e.cap -= tr;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += tr;
                        return tr;
                    }
                }
                ptr[v]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        floorplan = new Room[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room(i, j);
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected();
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        Dinic mf = new Dinic(n * n * (t + 1) + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];

                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }

                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }

                    if (!room.accessible[c]) continue;

                    if (i > 0 && floorplan[i - 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i - 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                    }
                    if (i < n - 1 && floorplan[i + 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i + 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                    }
                    if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j - 1].accessible[c]) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j - 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                    }
                    if (j < n - 1 && floorplan[i][j + 1].accessible[c]) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j + 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow(0, 1));
    }
}
